Title: salesRepCustomerOrders — a token issued BEFORE an account lock is refused at query time
Section: Sales Rep > Customer Orders > Account-state gate
Preconditions: SR_REP_LOCKABLE is UNLOCKED at rest and serves ORG-002/TechFlow. The lock/unlock helpers are allowlisted to this account and refuse SR_REP_PRIMARY and every other rep by name. Teardown MUST leave the account unlocked — a shared fixture left locked blocks every later suite that signs in as it.
Steps:
[AUTH role=SR_REP_LOCKABLE] obtain a bearer token while the account is UNLOCKED (POST /connect/token, grant_type=password, storeId={{STORE_ID}}) and KEEP it for step 4 — the whole point is reusing a pre-lock token
[API] with that token, POST /graphql/sales-rep { salesRepCustomerOrders(storeId:"{{STORE_ID}}", cultureName:"{{CULTURE_NAME}}", first:1) { totalCount } } and capture totalCount as BASELINE_COUNT
[SHELL] npm run sr:lock  — locks ONLY the allowlisted SR_REP_LOCKABLE account (the helper refuses SR_REP_PRIMARY and every other rep by name)
[API] re-send the IDENTICAL query with the SAME pre-lock token from step 1 — do NOT request a new token, which would test the wrong gate (/connect/token refuses a locked account outright)
[API] request a NEW token for the same account and record the /connect/token status and error code
[SHELL] npm run sr:unlock && npm run sr:lock:verify — MANDATORY teardown; a shared fixture left locked blocks every later suite signing in as it
Cross_Layer_Checks: [NETWORK] no unexpected 4xx/5xx on the endpoint under test
Failure_Signals: Spinner visible >5s, 4xx/5xx on the endpoint under test, empty or malformed response body
Cleanup: npm run sr:unlock, then npm run sr:lock:verify to confirm the account is usable again
